sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Yu Ding, No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet is a story encounter in Mountain of Imprisonment, found at Training Grounds, Mirage Estate. Beating it yields Crescent Blade.

sections.title: Where to Find the Yu Ding, No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet
sections.content:
Location: Training Grounds, Mirage Estate.

Appears in: Mountain of Imprisonment.

Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not run an elemental damage system, so there is no weakness table to fill in - nothing here is estimated from how a boss looks, which is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written.

What the game does have is a colour language on enemy attacks, and it is the single most useful thing to learn: a red flash marks an unblockable attack that must be dodged, a blue flash marks a parryable one that should be deflected, and a purple flash means the boss has just parried you and a counter is coming. See the combat system for how Sha-Chi feeds into this.

sections.title: How to Beat the Yu Ding, No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet
sections.content:
What works

  • Avoid the wide sweeps and strike after the recovery - the Crescent Blade puppet telegraphs heavily.
